analysis.method: 采用增强的背景优化提取方法从 VLT/MUSE 观测中提取恒星光谱，校正随波长变化的仪器响应，使用 SAPSAL 深度学习框架推导恒星参数，并结合局部 FUV 场的概率估计和近红外测光识别带盘恒星。
limits: 光学 veiling 采用简化估计。
citation_leads: Abstract: “We investigate the low-mass stellar population in the highly irradiated center of Trumpler 14 and examine how the local FUV radiation field influences circumstellar disk evolution.”

Abstract: “We extracted stellar spectra from VLT/MUSE observations using an enhanced background-optimized extraction method, carefully corrected for instrumental response as a function of wavelength and finally derived the stellar parameters with the SAPSAL deep-learning framework.”
Abstract: “We combined these results with a probabilistic estimate of the local FUV field and near-infrared photometry to identify disk-bearing stars.”
Abstract: “We identify 310 bona fide cluster members with an age of $0.66^{+0.73}_{-0.35}$ Myr”

Abstract: “The fraction of stars exhibiting near-infrared excess decreases from 30% at the lowest FUV fluxes to under 5% at $\log(FUV)\gtrsim5.6 \ G_{\mathrm{0}}$, while no significant correlation is found between our simplified estimate of the optical veiling and the local FUV field.”
Abstract: “The pronounced decline in the disk fraction with ambient FUV flux provides strong evidence for external photoevaporation rapidly dispersing circumstellar disks in the core of Trumpler 14.”
Abstract: “Our results confirm previous disk dispersal estimates and extend to higher values of the FUV field strength.”
analysis.research_progress: 确认此前的盘消散估计，并将结果扩展至更高的 FUV 场强。

analysis.reading_entry: 摘要
analysis.problem: 整合多巡天恒星测量，建立覆盖银河系内区至外晕、具有完整六维相空间信息且内部一致的恒星示踪体目录。
analysis.method: 将 Gaia DR3 天体测量与 14 个巡天的分光光度距离和视向速度交叉匹配；采用 Gaia 锚定的零点修正和统计归一化，利用联合光度与光谱数据推导分光光度视差，汇总重叠巡天数据以替换不可靠测量并补充缺失速度，最后使用球状星团、矮星系和恒星流进行外部验证。

analysis.problem: Sgr A* 耀发能否可靠地解释为局部高能等离子体的相干轨道运动，以及这种解释能否用于推断源的性质。

通常假定热点自身状态的演化时间尺度长于动力学时间尺度。
limits: 数据选择偏差和简化几何模型可能影响热点解释；模拟中也难以明确辨认单个明亮、相干的绕行体。

analysis.result: 两颗星的恒星性质相近，但变光行为明显不同。HD253659 持续呈现爆发式变光，在 2016—2022 年间发生一次主要爆发，TESS 数据中还有多次短时闪变；其颜色—星等图的环状行为与近极向观测的周星盘形成和消散相符。PY Gem 在过去约 20 年失去了爆发式变光，仅表现出小振幅 p 模和 g 模脉动，被归类为 βCephei 混合脉动星。两者均不符合演化晚期大质量恒星的解释，星云起源更可能与 Be 现象有关。
analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 确定具有 WISE 探测红外星云的 Be 星 PY Gem 和 HD253659 的基本物理参数及变光性质，并探讨其星云是否与晚期恒星演化或 Be 现象有关。
analysis.method: 通过光谱能量分布建模估计基本物理参数；结合地面巡天和 TESS 的档案测光，以及专门开展的多色测光与光谱监测，分析变光、颜色—星等图和发射线轮廓变化。
citation_leads: Abstract: “Here, we focus on two Be stars - PY Gem and HD253659 - whose nebulae were detected with the Wide-field Infrared Survey Explorer.”
Abstract: “We estimated their basic physical parameters from modelling the spectral energy distribution and examined their variability.”

Abstract: “We combined archival photometric data from several ground-based survey telescopes and from the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS) with our own data from dedicated multi-colour photometric and spectroscopic monitoring”
Abstract: “despite having similar stellar properties, the photometric variability of the two objects is strikingly different.”
Abstract: “For HD253659 we detected continuous eruptive variability and a major outburst that took place between 2016 and 2022 along with numerous flicker events seen in the TESS data.”
Abstract: “HD253659 also exhibits loop-like behaviour in the colour-magnitude diagram, consistent with build-up and dissipation phases of a circumstellar disk seen close to pole-on.”
Abstract: “In contrast, during the past ~20 years PY Gem has lost its eruptive variability and shows only small-amplitude p and g-mode pulsations classifying PY Gem as βCephei hybrid pulsator.”

Abstract: “Detailed analysis of these stars indicates that both objects are inconsistent with evolved massive stars, and that the origin of their nebulae is more likely linked to the physics of the Be phenomenon.”
analysis.research_progress: 针对两颗具有新发现红外星云的 Be 星，给出恒星参数和变光分析，揭示相近恒星性质下的显著变光差异，并提出其星云更可能源于 Be 现象而非晚期大质量恒星演化。

analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 测量跨越十个太阳周期的太阳全球尺度差异自转与子午环流，考察其周期间变化，为太阳发电机提供观测约束。
analysis.method: 对 Kodaikanal Solar Observatory 的数字化 Ca II K 色球层强度结构进行局部相关跟踪（LCT），覆盖太阳周期 14 至 23（1907—2007），并利用 PSPT 观测开展独立比较。

citation_leads: Abstract: “Global-scale solar surface flows, including differential rotation and meridional circulation, provide key observational constraints on the solar dynamo.”

Abstract: “We investigate these flows using local correlation tracking (LCT) of chromospheric intensity structures in digitized \ion{Ca}{2}~K observations from the Kodaikanal Solar Observatory covering Solar Cycles (SC) 14 to 23 (1907 -- 2007).”
Abstract: “The recovered differential rotation shows relatively small cycle-to-cycle variations and remains close to the Howard reference profile.”
Abstract: “The meridional flow is predominantly poleward in the earlier record and exhibits larger relative cycle-to-cycle variations and uncertainties.”
Abstract: “Incomplete coverage of SC~14 and sparse sampling during SC~21--23 limit detailed comparisons to the better-covered SC~15--20.”
Abstract: “An independent comparison using PSPT observations yields a full-period correlation of $r=0.91$ between the LCT and SDO/HMI meridional-flow profiles.”
Abstract: “it provided record for early cycles that are not commonly available;”
Abstract: “These results extend the observational context for solar-cycle-related flows over a century and motivate further refinement through data-driven reconstruction.”

Abstract: “In another case, a bound companion one quarter Titan's mass collides at \(45^\circ\) and about 3.7 km s\(^{-1}\), ejecting 0.60 Iapetus masses of ice.”

analysis.reason: 与研究组的超新星及致密天体瞬变观测方向有实质方法联系：利用宿主光谱红移快速估算光度、筛选超亮超新星和千新星候选，并安排后随观测。宿主误关联、AGN污染及历史重复爆发的排查也有助于构建可靠瞬变样本。但论文主要贡献是筛选基础设施及运行验证，并未直接约束超新星中心引擎、周星介质或致密天体辐射机制，因此列为 worth_knowing。
analysis.result: 2020—2024年约12万条TNS记录的回溯分析中，约15%获得目视确认的DESI宿主匹配，最终形成5400个具有合格峰值拟合的Gold Sample，包括3569个未分类瞬变和1831个已分类超新星。正文校准结果显示真宿主恢复率约93%、错误星系指派低于1%。2025年实时运行首先凭异常亮度标记引力透镜SLSN SN 2025wny，并参与后随验证；SN 2025sei经后续测光和可靠宿主确认被确认为SLSN。两例档案千新星候选经长期历史或强制测光检查均被排除，2025年搜索未得到可行千新星候选。AT 2025aagx的透镜建模不支持具有可探测多重像的强透镜解释。
analysis.reading_entry: Special Target Identification and Follow-up Triggering
analysis.problem: 瞬变发现数量超过光谱分类能力时，如何利用已有宿主光谱红移，实时提供距离和光度背景信息，可靠关联宿主、优先筛选稀有瞬变并分配后随资源，同时建立可用于种群分析的样本。
analysis.method: DETECT每小时读取TNS报告，以HEALPix索引在30角秒内搜索DESI光谱，并使用Legacy Surveys DR10形态信息构造方向光半径归一化距离进行宿主关联，而非简单最近邻匹配。依星系轮廓采用不同阈值，歧义和红移冲突交人工审核。结合宿主红移、银河消光及仅含带宽项的K校正估算绝对星等，以高光度、核区位置、宿主性质、透镜邻近和快速衰减等标签排序。回溯样本用Haffet拟合合格多波段光变；千新星筛选对照possis模型及AT 2017gfo，并用多年档案和强制测光复核；个别透镜候选另用lenstronomy建模。
limits: 该框架用于快速筛选、后随排序和种群分析，不能替代瞬变自身的光谱分类；前景与背景宿主混淆有时仍需瞬变光谱解决。
DESI偏向明亮、大质量宿主，固定角搜索半径也带来选择限制；作者不对宿主偏移统计中残余的类型差异作物理解读。

analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: APOGEE 长期径向速度重复性受仪器零点系统误差限制，包括曝光间漂移与光纤相关偏移；灯源波长校准只能部分追踪这些误差，且偏移可能随光纤维护或更换而演化。
analysis.method: 利用已发表的逐次观测径向速度和共享重复观测构建 uber-calibration 框架，依次求解（plate, night）曝光级偏移与随时间变化的（fiber, observing year）偏移；分别应用于 APO 和 LCO 的 DR17 以及 APO 的 DR19。
citation_leads: Abstract: “enabling more reliable RV variability, binary, and Galactic-dynamics studies.”

Abstract: “Long-term RV repeatability is nevertheless limited by instrumental zero-point systematics: exposure-to-exposure drift and fiber-dependent offsets that are only partially tracked by lamp-based wavelength calibration, and that can evolve as fibers are serviced or replaced.”
Abstract: “We infer and remove these zero points directly from the published per-visit RVs using an uber-calibration framework based on shared repeat observations.”
Abstract: “We solve sequentially for two sets of minimal calibration units: (plate, night) exposure-level offsets and time-dependent (fiber, observing year) offsets.”
Abstract: “We apply the method independently to APO and LCO DR17 and to APO DR19.”

Abstract: “After correction, the same-fiber repeatability within two days reaches a limiting precision of ~14 m/s, and the long-baseline single-visit precision improves by a factor of two from 98.2 to 44.7 m/s.”

analysis.reading_entry: 摘要
analysis.problem: 如何结合解析可控的旋近物理与数值相对论提供的非线性强场信息，建模完整的旋近—并合—铃振信号。
analysis.method: 保留频域振幅的领先阶项和 3.5 阶后牛顿 TaylorF2 相位，将数值相对论相对于解析旋近波形的贡献表示为振幅和相位残差修正，使用 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络从 SXS 波形中学习这些修正；训练后将修正存储为显式样条函数，波形求值不再需要网络。
citation_leads: Abstract: “Modeling the full inspiral-merger-ringdown signal requires combining analytically controlled inspiral physics with the nonlinear strong-field information supplied by numerical relativity.”

Abstract: “Our models show that engulfment occurring during the late main-sequence (MS) stage yields significantly higher surface enrichment than at the ZAMS.”
Abstract: “Rotational mixing generally suppresses enrichment; however, metal-poor stars can sustain super-solar abundances for several Gyr, whereas high-metallicity stars remain largely unaffected.”

Abstract: “Although engulfment causes an instantaneous spin-up, this angular momentum injection is transient, and the star quickly re-converges to its standard rotational evolution. Thus, MS spin-up cannot serve as a long-term observational indicator.”

Abstract: “Because convective envelope thickness and MS lifetime dictate the magnitude and duration of enrichment, identifying engulfment signatures requires balancing the long-lived but diluted signals in 0.7 M_sun stars against the strong yet short-lived enrichment in 1.2 M_sun stars.”
Abstract: “Consequently, 1.0 M_sun stars offering both substantial enrichment and a relatively long MS lifetime represent optimal targets for observational searches.”

analysis.result: 作者构造了两种过程的总率辅助函数近似及可解析反演的四阶 Padé 累积概率近似。同步辐射辅助函数在 χ_e∈(10⁻³,10²) 内相对误差低于 0.7%；Breit–Wheeler 辅助函数在 χ_γ≳1 时相对误差不超过 3.3×10⁻⁴。累积概率导数检验及每种过程 9 万次事件的抽样检验表明，单过程采样谱达到约百分之一精度；较大的相对偏差通常位于谱值很小的区域。这些结果不构成完整级联精度或实际运行加速的验证。
analysis.reading_entry: Discussion
analysis.problem: 如何在强场 QED 蒙特卡洛模拟中，高效抽样同步辐射及非线性 Breit–Wheeler 成对产生的事件发生时间和产物能量分配，避免依赖含特殊函数积分的查找表、插值及累积概率的迭代反演。
analysis.method: 在恒定交叉电磁场背景下推导过程谱，以辅助函数表示总反应率；抽样最终光学深度并累积总率确定事件时刻。通过加权误差最小化拟合辅助函数和四阶 Padé 累积概率，将能量分配反演化为四次方程的解析求根，再由守恒确定另一产物的量子参数。以累积概率导数恢复的谱和随机采样直方图进行独立检验，并为数值异常设置低精度后备反演。
limits: 精度检验仅针对孤立的单过程，未检验误差在完整模拟或级联中的累积。
少数同步辐射参数组合会产生微小负根号量；后备 Padé 反演精度低于完整四次 Padé 模型。
citation_leads: Introduction: “The approximations of the auxiliary functions stay within $0.7\%$ (synchrotron) and $0.1\%$ (Breit-Wheeler, for $\chi_\gamma \gtrsim 1$) of the exact functions, and the sampled spectra agree with theory at the percent level.”
Implementation: “We instead approximate $p(\chi, \chi_1)$ itself by a form that is both accurate and invertible in closed form, which yields an analytic formula for $\chi_1$.”
Results: “Two independent tests measure how well the approximations reproduce the physics.”
Discussion: “Both tests probe a single process in isolation, and neither follows how the errors accumulate over a full simulation.”
Solution of a quartic equation: “This approximation is not as accurate as the quartic Padé model, so it is only used when the full solution does not return a valid value for $r$.”

Breit-Wheeler process: “We remove the discontinuity as in the synchrotron case, by fixing a continuous approximating form for $n(\chi_\gamma)$ and re-fitting $a(\chi_\gamma)$ and $b(\chi_\gamma)$ with it.”
analysis.research_progress: 提供了无需查表、插值或迭代求逆的初等函数采样方案，并给出拟合参数、四次方程物理解选择及数值后备处理。增量在于将两种常用强场 QED 过程的事件率计算和能量抽样转化为可直接实现的解析近似，同时用两种独立的单过程检验量化其精度；尚未证明完整级联中的误差控制或生产级性能收益。

analysis.reason: 研究对象是贫金属T型褐矮星，重点为低温大气成分、物理参数及其与Gaia-Enceladus银河系子结构的关联；摘要未呈现与FRB/PRS环境、超新星中心引擎、激波破越、周星介质相互作用或致密天体高能观测等研究方向的实质联系。
analysis.result: 大气模型拟合得到有效温度960^{+28}_{-32} K、太阳标度金属丰度[M/H] = -1.16^{+0.28}_{-0.25} dex。测得径向速度为-163 ± 5 km/s，结合自行和估计距离推得高度偏心的银河系轨道（e ≥ 0.9）。其运动学、金属丰度与适度α元素增强共同支持其与Gaia-Enceladus子结构的关联。
analysis.reading_entry: 摘要
analysis.problem: 刻画贫金属T型褐矮星WISEA J155349.96+693355.2的大气性质，并检验其运动学和化学性质是否支持与Gaia-Enceladus银河系子结构的关联。
analysis.method: 使用JWST NIRSpec/prism与MIRI/LRS联合光谱覆盖0.6–12 μm，并与一组大气模型比较；采用测光距离推算总辐射光度及有效温度；利用NIRSpec/G395H中等分辨率光谱测量径向速度，结合自行与估计距离分析银河系轨道。
assumptions: 推算总辐射光度时采用测光距离。
limits: 三角视差存在不确定性，可能受Lutz-Kelker偏差影响而被高估。
citation_leads: Abstract: “We present JWST NIRSpec and MIRI observations of the metal-poor T dwarf WISEA J155349.96+693355.2.”
Abstract: “The combined NIRSpec/prism plus MIRI/LRS spectrum (R ~ 100) provides 0.6-12 $μ$m spectroscopic coverage”

Abstract: “Comparison of the spectral data to a suite of atmosphere models yields an effective temperature $T_{\rm eff}$ = 960$^{+28}_{-32}$ K and a solar-scaled metallicity of [M/H] = -1.16$^{+0.28}_{-0.25}$ dex.”
Abstract: “We find indications that the uncertain trigonometric parallax, likely subject to Lutz-Kelker bias, may be overestimated.”
Abstract: “Adopting the photometric distance yields a bolometric luminosity”

Abstract: “From the moderate-resolution (R ~ 3,000) NIRSpec/G395H spectrum, we measure a radial velocity of -163 $\pm$ 5 km/s, which combined with the source's measured proper motion and estimated distance indicates a highly eccentric (e $\geq$ 0.9) Galactic orbit consistent with an accreted halo object.”

Abstract: “The UVW kinematics of WISEA J155349.96+693355.2, its bulk metallicity, and its modest alpha enrichment ([$α$/Fe] = +0.15$^{+0.04}_{-0.06}$ dex) are all equivalent to stars identified in the Gaia-Enceladus Milky Way substructure, making it the first brown dwarf with kinematic and chemical evidence of association.”
analysis.research_progress: 作者报告了首个具有运动学和化学证据支持其与Gaia-Enceladus银河系子结构关联的褐矮星。

analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 能否利用低频热轫致辐射的圆偏振观测，测量日心距离大于约 1.1 个太阳半径处的日冕磁场，以补充瞬态射电暴之外较少见的测量。
analysis.method: 使用 Gauribidanur RAdioheliograPH（GRAPH）进行 51 MHz 总强度与圆偏振强度的二维成像，计算圆偏振度，并结合射线追踪模拟估计射电源位置和磁场强度。
limits: 摘要报告的是一项个案研究。
citation_leads: Abstract: “Measurements of the magnetic field strength in the solar corona at heliocentric distances $r\,{\gtrsim}\,1.1\,R_{\odot}$, using observations other than transient radio bursts, are rare.”

Abstract: “We report a case study of two-dimensional imaging observations of the above mentioned circular polarization in the solar corona at 51\,MHz using the Gauribidanur RAdioheliograPH (GRAPH), and estimates of the associated coronal magnetic field strength.”
Abstract: “The peak degree of circular polarization ($dcp$), calculated from the observed total and circularly polarized intensity images with the GRAPH, is ${\approx}$2.7%.”

Abstract: “Using ray-tracing simulations we find that the observed peak $dcp$ corresponds to a radio source located at $r\,{\approx}\,1.65\,{\pm}\,0.15\,R_{\odot}$ at 51 MHz, and its field strength is ${\approx}\,1.55\,{\pm}\,0.3\,$Gauss.”

analysis.reason: 研究重点是卫星星系淬火的空间各向异性及其几何起源。AGN 喷流仅作为反馈解释的背景约束，并未实质研究相对论喷流、高能瞬变或所列其他研究方向，因此在摘要筛选阶段跳过。
analysis.result: 摘要报告，卫星淬火各向异性主要源于已淬火与未淬火群体的空间分离：已淬火卫星更集中于中心，并更强地沿中心星系长轴排列；未淬火卫星分布在更大半径且更接近各向同性。该行为在无恒星或 AGN 反馈的模拟中仍存在。晕边界外的信号在不同模拟间差异显著，并与长轴方向的星系数目过剩相关。
analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 解释为何大质量晕中的卫星星系优先沿中心星系长轴淬火，以及这一现象与 AGN 喷流通常沿短轴指向之间的关系，并研究晕外尺度上的各向异性淬火。
analysis.method: 使用 z=0 的 SIMBA、TNG100、EAGLE 和无反馈 SIMBA 宇宙学模拟，比较已淬火与未淬火卫星的空间分布及晕内外各向异性信号。
citation_leads: Abstract: “Satellite galaxies in massive halos are seen to be preferentially quenched along the major axes of their central galaxies.”
Abstract: “In contrast, the AGN jet tends to point along the minor axis, which imposes interesting constraints on the role of AGN feedback in satellite galaxy quenching.”

Abstract: “Here we use the SIMBA, TNG100, EAGLE, and feedback-free SIMBA cosmological simulations at $z=0$ to show that this satellite anisotropy primarily originates from spatial segregation between quenched and unquenched populations.”

Abstract: “Quenched satellites are more centrally concentrated and more strongly aligned with the central galaxy's major axis, whereas unquenched satellites occupy larger radii and are more nearly isotropic.”
Abstract: “The persistence of this behaviour without stellar or active galactic nucleus feedback suggests that feedback is not important for satellite quenching.”
Abstract: “Beyond the halo boundary, the signal varies strongly among simulations and correlates with the excess number of galaxies along the major axis.”
Abstract: “This links large-scale anisotropic quenching to the direction-dependent distribution of groups, clusters and filamentary environments.”
Abstract: “Our results provide a unified geometrical interpretation of anisotropic satellite quenching across halo and extra-halo scales.”
analysis.research_progress: 提出以空间分离为核心的几何解释，将晕内卫星淬火各向异性与晕外方向依赖的群、星系团及丝状环境分布联系起来。

analysis.result: 孤立星系更倾向于蓝色、盘状且正在形成恒星，但与成组星系的性质存在广泛重叠。仅考虑恒星形成星系并控制质量后，两类星系的恒星形成和恒星族未呈现差异。作者据此认为，至少在富星系团之外，现今恒星形成星系的演化过去和现在均由内部过程主导。
analysis.reading_entry: 摘要
analysis.problem: 最孤立的星系是否具有特殊的物理性质，以及它们与成组星系在恒星形成和恒星族方面是否存在差异。
analysis.method: 利用 GAMA 巡天和客观的孤立程度度量研究最孤立星系；比较孤立与成组星系的物理性质，并在恒星形成星系子样本中控制质量进行比较。
assumptions: 作者关于内部过程主导演化的推论以孤立样本缺乏显著相互作用为前提。
limits: 控制质量后未发现差异的结论仅针对恒星形成星系。

Abstract: “isolated galaxies are preferentially the former. However, there is a broad overlap in properties, with some isolated galaxies sharing the latter characteristics.”

analysis.reading_entry: 摘要
analysis.problem: 如何确定 AGN 超快外流的物理性质和能量学，并理解吸积盘风与星系尺度外流之间的物理耦合，以评估其对星系演化的影响。
analysis.method: 综述近期观测进展，重点讨论高分辨率 X 射线光谱，并结合 UV、光学、IR 和毫米波观测对不同尺度及不同物质相外流的示踪。
limits: 吸积盘风与星系尺度外流之间的物理耦合仍是 AGN 反馈中的主要未解问题之一。
citation_leads: Abstract: “Ultra-fast outflows (UFOs), launched from the inner accretion disc in active galactic nuclei (AGN), are among the prime candidates for driving AGN feedback in their host galaxies.”
Abstract: “Determining their physical properties and energetics is therefore essential for assessing their impact on galaxy evolution.”
Abstract: “This review highlights recent observational progress, with particular emphasis on the groundbreaking insights enabled by high-resolution X-ray spectroscopy.”
Abstract: “The first X-Ray Imaging and Spectroscopy Mission (XRISM)/Resolve observations of AGN winds have revealed that the innermost UFOs are kinematically structured and inhomogeneous.”
Abstract: “In the archetypal quasar PDS 456, these observations have led to a substantial upward revision of the inferred mass outflow rate, momentum flux and kinetic power.”
Abstract: “Complementary UV, optical, IR and mm observations trace the ionised, atomic and molecular phases of AGN-driven outflows from parsec to galactic scales.”
Abstract: “However, the physical coupling between the accretion-disc wind and the galactic outflows remains one of the major unresolved questions in AGN feedback.”
analysis.research_progress: 摘要强调 XRISM/Resolve 对内侧超快外流结构和非均匀性的观测进展，以及这些结果对 PDS 456 外流能量学估计的修订；这是综述所总结的进展，不能据摘要认定为本文自身的新观测结果。

analysis.reason: 论文研究暗物质尖峰和吸积盘对 EMRI 引力波波形及参数测量的影响。虽涉及致密天体和吸积环境，但摘要未呈现与 FRB/PRS、超新星中心引擎、激波与周星介质、相对论喷流、中微子或致密天体高能观测的实质联系；提到电磁对应体仅作为打破参数简并的可能条件。因此按研究效用在摘要阶段跳过，而非因其结果属于增量研究。
analysis.result: 暗物质动力学摩擦引起的相位偏移在中心黑洞质量约为 10^6 个太阳质量时达到峰值，约为 10^2–10^3 rad；此时暗物质尖峰斜率可达到亚百分比测量精度，两种暗物质效应均可明确探测。吸积盘参数在所探索的参数空间内仍然简并，联合分析还发现暗物质斜率与盘参数之间的跨组分简并。
analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 暗物质尖峰与吸积盘如何共同影响偏心、赤道面 Kerr EMRI 的波形，以及这些环境效应和参数能否被测量。
analysis.method: 将暗物质动力学摩擦、暗物质自引力、牛顿吸积盘力矩和盘自引力四种效应纳入五阶后牛顿增强的解析 kludge（AAK）波形模型，并以 Fisher 矩阵分析评估可测量性。
assumptions: 研究对象限定为偏心、赤道面 Kerr EMRI。
吸积盘力矩采用牛顿模型。
limits: 吸积盘参数在所探索的参数空间内保持简并；亚声速到超声速的转变仅略微削弱简并，不能消除它。
暗物质斜率与盘参数存在跨组分简并，Fisher 矩阵接近奇异；独立测量盘参数需要相对论力矩模型或电磁对应体。
citation_leads: Abstract: “are prime targets for the space-based gravitational-wave interferometers”
Abstract: “We quantify the joint imprint of a dark matter (DM) spike and an accretion disk on the waveforms of eccentric, equatorial Kerr EMRIs”

Abstract: “integrating four modular effects---DM dynamical friction, DM self-gravity, Newtonian accretion-disk torques, and disk self-gravity---into a fifth post-Newtonian (5PN) augmented analytic kludge (AAK) waveform model, and assess their measurability via a Fisher-matrix analysis.”

Abstract: “The DM dynamical-friction dephasing peaks at $M_1\sim 10^6\,M_\odot$, reaching $\sim 10^2$--$10^3\,\mathrm{rad}$; there the DM spike slope is measurable to sub-percent precision and both DM channels are unambiguously detectable”

Abstract: “The disk parameters remain degenerate across the explored parameter space, since the supersonic regime dominates the inspiral and the subsonic-to-supersonic transition only mildly weakens this degeneracy without lifting it”
Abstract: “a combined DM$+$disk analysis further reveals a cross-sector degeneracy between the DM slope and the disk parameters.”

Abstract: “This physical degeneracy, reflected in the near-singular Fisher matrix, implies that independently measuring the disk parameters requires a relativistic torque model or an electromagnetic counterpart.”
analysis.research_progress: 在同一 AAK 波形框架中联合纳入暗物质尖峰与吸积盘的四种环境效应，量化其可测量性，并识别暗物质斜率与盘参数之间的跨组分简并。

analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 随着高质量星系 SED 的数量和信息量增加，如何以计算上可承受的成本，对更灵活的恒星族模型进行完整贝叶斯推断。
analysis.method: 使用 JAX 构建 GPU 原生、端到端可微的 SED 前向模型，涵盖恒星族、星云辐射、尘埃消光与辐射以及观测者参考系投影；通过向量化编译架构并行替换嵌套采样的活点，并以自动微分为梯度采样器提供精确梯度。联合推断随时间变化的化学富集历史，展示约 120 个年龄分箱的非参数恒星形成历史，并利用 FSPS 的 α 增强恒星库联合采样恒星 [α/Fe] 与 [Fe/H] 等参数。
citation_leads: Abstract: “Analysing these datasets requires stellar-population models that are both flexible and computationally efficient.”

Abstract: “We present CERIDWEN, a GPU-native SED fitting framework written in JAX, with an end-to-end differentiable forward model spanning stellar populations, nebular emission, dust attenuation and emission, and projection into the observer frame.”

Abstract: “Its vectorised, compiled architecture lets nested sampling replace a batch of live points in parallel on the GPU, which makes flexible stellar-population models tractable under full Bayesian inference.”
Abstract: “Automatic differentiation also provides exact gradients for the gradient-based samplers in the package.”

Abstract: “We jointly infer time-dependent chemical-enrichment histories instead of a single stellar metallicity, and demonstrate non-parametric star-formation histories (SFHs) with $\sim$120 age bins.”

Abstract: “Using $α$-enhanced stellar libraries from FSPS, CERIDWEN can sample stellar [$α$/Fe] jointly with [Fe/H], mass, and SFH, so that the joint posterior represents the [Fe/H]-[$α$/Fe] degeneracy explicitly.”

Abstract: “In controlled mocks, CERIDWEN recovers parameters with well-calibrated posterior uncertainties, while fits to real JWST observations reproduce posteriors from the established Prospector framework: on a single GPU, CERIDWEN completes a fit in a median sampling time of $\sim$4 min, $\sim$134$\times$ faster per fit than equivalent CPU-based Prospector runs.”

Abstract: “CERIDWEN therefore makes full Bayesian inference practical for larger galaxy samples and more flexible stellar-population models, reducing computational constraints on the physical complexity explored in SED fitting.”
analysis.research_progress: 以 GPU 加速降低灵活恒星族模型的完整贝叶斯推断成本，同时显式表示 [Fe/H]–[α/Fe] 的联合后验简并，使更大星系样本和更复杂 SED 模型的推断更加可行。

analysis.method: 采用25 M☉恒星的高分辨率三维PPM欧拉流体力学模拟，包含氧燃烧壳层、碳燃烧壳层及其间辐射层，并设置不同分辨率、包层范围、加热/无加热控制和主动12C+12C燃烧模型。通过熵扩散方程反演D(r)，结合分辨率序列、惰性示踪流体和边界处理比较来区分物理混合、热扩散、初始结构松弛和数值扩散；随后用球对称扩散方程外推熵剖面演化。
assumptions: 模型以半径依赖的不透明度和静态加热处理三维辐射物理，并用边界处理限定未建模的两个对流区响应。

analysis.result: 三种初始混合磁场在动力学弛豫后形成不同的准稳态构型，保留不同程度的初始多极记忆，并未趋向唯一或普适的磁平衡。三模型整体均由极向场主导，恒星主体内角平均环向/极向磁场RMS幅度比约为20%–40%，但这一共同径向特征不能代表完整的多极组成、非轴对称性或磁力线拓扑。高阶模态贡献显著，局域仍存在环向增强区域。
analysis.reading_entry: IV Discussion and Conclusions
analysis.problem: 相对论中子星中的混合极向—环向磁场，在动力学不稳定性饱和后是否趋向唯一稳定构型；不同初始磁场几何能保留多少记忆，以及共同的环向/极向径向比例能否代表完整磁场结构。

analysis.method: 作者结合 SILVERRUSH 多窄带 LAE 星表与 COSMOS-Web 的 JWST/NIRCam F115W、F150W、F277W 和 F444W 成像，对源进行二维 Sérsic 轮廓拟合并开展尺寸相关性统计。
assumptions: 单分量 Sérsic 轮廓能够有效表征这些高红移 LAE 的半光半径与整体形态。

Ly$\alpha$ 等效宽度与紧致度的相关性主要由接近分辨率极限的源驱动，环境分析也仅基于投影大尺度环境，因而存在分辨率和投影效应限制。

must_read.text: 从78个CHIME/FRB Outriggers定位事件出发，筛选8个矮宿主候选，经恒星质量分析确认5个新矮宿主，log(M*/M☉)约为8.1–9.1。

must_read.text: 三维模拟显示，氧燃烧壳层对流激发的内重力波能够混合碳燃烧壳底部的熵和元素，使窄的N²峰在数小时内削弱约35%–40%。

must_read.label: SN 2025aedz: A typical short-plateau type IIP supernova with rapid post-peak decline
must_read.text: SN 2025aedz 的峰值绝对 r 波段星等为 −17.16±0.03 mag，平台持续约50±3天，放射性尾部对应约0.03±0.01太阳质量的56Ni。

must_read.text: POPKIN将单星和双星演化、银河系恒星形成与金属丰度历史、银河势中的轨道动力学以及吸积和微引力透镜后处理结合起来。
